items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: I don't remember him exactly. Now, when I lived in Natchez, this company came there and made a picture. Colleen Moore was a star of it.

ctx.x: And Elmore Russ, they have that. I don't, I'm not familiar with him. Who? Elmore Russ, I'm not familiar with him.
I'm not either. Elmore Russ. Oh! I don't remember him exactly. Now, when I lived in Natchez, this company came there and made a picture. Colleen Moore was a star of it. Do you remember her?
